verified_facts.text: The hotel is a short walk from Roppongi Station and provides easy access to areas such as Ginza and Shibuya.

verified_facts.text: The design incorporates subtle Japanese aesthetics with rich mahogany furnishings made with natural woods and fabrics.
verified_facts.excerpt: Grand Hyatt Tokyo incorporates subtle Japanese aesthetics into the design and offers rich mahogany furnishings made with natural woods and fabrics to create a warm residential ambience.

verified_facts.text: Rooms feature high ceilings, furniture by B&B Italia and light earth-tone colors and textures.
verified_facts.excerpt: Featuring high ceilings, furniture by B&B Italia and light earth-tone colors and textures, these spacious hotel rooms offer the ideal environment for relaxation.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have a work desk with Arne Jacobsen's Oxford chair and beds with Egyptian cotton linens by Frette.

verified_facts.text: Room bathrooms have a deep soaking tub that fills within five minutes.

verified_facts.text: Rooms on the 11th to 20th floors offer views that can include Tokyo Tower, the skyline and Mt. Fuji on a clear day.

verified_facts.text: The top-floor suite has a private heated outdoor pool and a sundeck with sweeping views of Tokyo.

verified_facts.text: A corner room on the 21st floor has its own private Japanese garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: corner room on the 21st floor with two luxurious queen-sized beds and a 30-square-meter (322 square feet) private Japanese garden

verified_facts.text: A family suite comes with a children's tent, plushies and decorations, a Japanese-style bathtub and a connecting room for space to play.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enter a world of imagination with a children’s tent, plushies and decorations, soak up to the shoulders in our Japanese-style bathtub

verified_facts.text: The spa's illuminated whirlpool is adorned with platinum tiles made in Italy.
